## Exclusions
Excluded from the Uptime Calculation are Service Feature
failures resulting from (i) Customer’s acts, omissions, or
misuse of the applicable GitHub service including violations of
the Agreement; (ii) failure of Customer’s internet connectivity;
(iii) factors outside GitHub's reasonable control, including
force majeure events; or (iv) Customer’s equipment, services, or
other technology.
